builds.name: Stranglethorns ceiling
builds.summary: R deals 400+.7 AP and enrages existing plants for 50% extra attack damage. Fix two Q-grown plants and count their actual attacks for an 8s R/plant window.
builds.goal: R deals 400+.7 AP and enrages existing plants for 50% extra attack damage. Fix two Q-grown plants and count their actual attacks for an 8s R/plant window.
builds.hypothesis:
Zyra summons the fury of nature, growing a twisted thicket that deals [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upwards, Knocking Up for [1] second.

Zyra's plants within the thicket become enraged, resetting their duration, gaining [50]% Health and Attacking for [50]% bonus damage.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers. PlantDamage helper is level interpolation(15 to 75)+.2 AP per hit, multiplied by 1.5 when enraged; two plants attacking same target may have attenuation and need observed hit values.

Spawn exactly two Thorn Spitters then R; measure 8s, log slam and plant attacks separately, crit never auto-multiplies pet damage. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Rune reasoning: Zyra — Stranglethorns: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Zyra's plants within the thicket become enraged, resetting their duration, g Deathfire Touch: Burn is a separate packet with real refresh/ramp rules, not extra native ticks. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly15 earned stacks give85HP; equipped Riftmaker converts actual bonus HP into AP for this helper. No additional lifesteal damage or free stacks. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Axiom targets eligible native ultimate output. Check single-target versus area classification, and pet/on-hit/transform/true-damage exceptions. Its takedown refund is not extra damage inside one fixed cast. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Bloodline: exactly15 earned legend stacks for85HP; read the actual Riftmaker HP-to-AP result before the scored event.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Shadowflame, Riftmaker, Liandry's Torment, Blackfire Torch. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zyra spawns Seeds around herself every [characterLevelInterpolation(13.6 → 9.05; raw flags preserved)] seconds that last 30 seconds. She can have 8 Seeds planted at once. If an enemy champion steps on a Seed, it dies. Zyra will not spawn Seeds while hiding in brush.

These Seeds are used by her other Abilities to spawn plants that deal [characterLevelInterpolation(15 → 75; raw flags preserved) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage.
